design: Short wiry mountain-route courier with an angular bony face, narrow four mandibles, dreadlocks assembled into a tall compact topknot and a few short side locks. Rope coils on one hip, long sealed cylindrical dispatch container diagonally across the back, light climbing harness, triangular woven waist wrap and forearm wraps. Busy tying a small cord knot at waist with both hands. Muted brown-olive skin.
